The Einstein Recommendations API has two main functions: to receive activities and to output recommendations.

For setup and usage information information, see [Einstein Recommendations](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/commerce/einstein-api/guide/einstein-recommendations-overview.html) in the Guides section.
